response.sql: WITH dc AS (SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM client GROUP BY district_id), tot AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS t FROM dc) SELECT d.A3 AS region, AVG(dc.cnt) AS avg_clients_per_district, AVG(CAST(dc.cnt AS REAL) / tot.t) AS avg_share FROM dc JOIN district d ON d.district_id = dc.district_id CROSS JOIN tot GROUP BY d.A3

assumptions.assumption: The share's denominator is the total client count across all districts with clients, which equals the total number of clients. Every client's district_id matches a district row, so the join drops no clients.
Districts with no clients are excluded, as the request says.
